column1: # Book 6 second-round read (Fable, 2026-10-30): every line read against the Latin. No changes.
# 6.1151-1152 ipsum goes with cor: into the very heart.
# 6.1189 salsa is an adjective on sputa; "and salt" had become a second color.
# 6.1244-1245 pudor and vox are the two subjects of cogebat; the voice was not a third cause of going down.

column2: Then, when through the throat it had filled the chest, and into the very
grieving heart of the sick the force of disease had flowed,
and salty, brought up through the throat with difficulty by a hoarse cough.
and by the labor they were then compelled to undergo by
shame, and the weary's coaxing voice mixed with the voice of complaint.
